summary: Computes a DST transition date (start or end) for a year and stores it together with a millisecond time-of-day into the DST globals at 0x5E77F0/0x5E77F8 (start) or 0x5E7800/0x5E7808 (end). Supports two rule modes: a weekday-based rule (a2 == 1) that computes a day-of-year from month a3, week a5, weekday a6 and a month-offset lookup indexed by year a4, or a fixed-date rule (a2 != 1) that adds a year-indexed month offset a7. The stored time-of-day is normalized across the 86400000 ms day boundary, rolling the stored day by one when it under/overflows. Called by sub_59249B (0059249b).

local_names.a1: 1 selects the start-date path, otherwise the end-date path
local_names.a2: 1 selects the weekday rule, otherwise the fixed-date rule
local_names.a3: month / year value stored to the DST year globals
local_names.a4: year used to index the month-offset lookup tables
local_names.a5: week-of-month for the weekday rule; also compared to 5 for last-week handling
local_names.a7: day offset for the fixed-date rule
local_names.v12: month offset read from a lookup table
local_names.v16: table value used for last-week correction
local_names.v17: month offset read for the fixed-date rule
local_names.v20: sign flag of the summed end-time value
local_names.v22: a3 & 3, selects which lookup table pair is used
local_names.result: final time-of-day in milliseconds, also the function return value

operations.description: Branches on a2: value 1 takes the weekday rule, any other value takes the fixed-date rule
Selects the month-offset table by a3 & 3: dword_5E9AD0 or dword_5E9B04 indexed by year a4, giving v12
Computes the day-of-week term v14 as (365*a3 + ((a3-1)>>2) + v12 + 1 - 25563) mod 7
Builds the transition day v15: if v14 > a6 then a6 + 7*a5 - v14 + v13 else v13 + a6 + 7*a5 - v14 - 7
Last-week correction: when a5 == 5, reads dword_5E9AD4 or dword_5E9B08 indexed by a4 and subtracts 7 from v15 if v15 exceeds that table value
Fixed-date rule: v15 = a7 + v17, where v17 is read from dword_5E9AD0 or dword_5E9B04 indexed by a4
Branches on a1: value 1 selects the DST start-date path, otherwise the end-date path
Start path: writes a3 to dword_5E77F0 (start year) and v15 to dword_5E77F4 (start day-of-year)
Start path: time-of-day in milliseconds = a11 + 1000*(a10 + 60*(a9 + 60*a8))
Start path: writes the computed time-of-day to dword_5E77F8 and returns it
End path: writes v15 to dword_5E7804 (end day-of-year)
End path: time-of-day in milliseconds = a11 + 1000*(a10 + dword_5E7760 + 60*(a9 + 60*a8)), adding the read-only global as an offset
End path: writes the summed time-of-day to dword_5E7808

Day-boundary normalization: if the sum is negative, adds 86400000 and decrements v15; if it is at least 86400000, subtracts 86400000 and increments v15; the corrected value is written back to dword_5E7804
End path: writes a3 to dword_5E7800 (end year) and returns the normalized time-of-day
Invoked by sub_59249B (0059249b), the only known caller in this packet

unresolved: The exact semantics of the two lookup-table pairs (dword_5E9AD0/dword_5E9AD4 vs dword_5E9B04/dword_5E9B08) and the rule constants 25563, 365, 7 and 86400000 are not derivable from this packet
The read-only role of dword_5E7760 in the end-date time computation (fill suggests a DST offset, unverified) is unclear
Why the weekday rule is gated on a2 == 1 while the fixed-date rule covers everything else is not justified by any packet evidence
